lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, with spot size and inter-centroid distance increasing progressively from the posterior gill margin toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 12 high-luminance spots distributed irregularly across its lateral surface, with higher density observed on the anterior half of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank patterning.
